### A Life of Blessing and Rest
Author: Nicholas Batzig
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/life-blessing-and-rest
Passage: Galatians 3:13
Points:
- Humanity forfeited God's original blessing and fell under the curse through Adam's sin.
- God's covenant curses throughout Scripture demonstrate His justice and the penalty of transgression.
- Jesus took the full weight and imagery of the curse upon Himself as the second Adam.
- On the cross, Christ was cursed so that believers could receive God's eternal blessings.
- Sinners laboring under guilt find justification and true rest through faith in Christ's finished work.

### The Curse of the Cross
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/curse-cross
Passage: Galatians 3:10-14
Points:
- Biblical covenants establish blessings for obedience and curses for disobedience.
- The ultimate curse is being cast out from God's merciful presence into judgment.
- Jesus endured this curse on the cross by being forsaken by the Father in our place.
- Christ took the wrath due to sinners while preserving the divine unity of the Trinity.
- Those who belong to Christ will never have to fear being abandoned by God.
